exposure: Enhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) protocol for post-cesarean pain management
outcome: Total opioid use in the first 48 hours after cesarean
cohort: 200 women undergoing scheduled cesarean deliveries (100 pre-ERAS and 100 post-ERAS)
finding: Implementation of an ERAS protocol for post-cesarean pain management significantly reduced opioid use and improved pain scores in the first 48 hours after cesarean delivery.
